name: agentdeck-desktop
description: AgentDeck desktop app: a window on the AgentDeck server (Linux).
author: Ninjalama <miron.schueler@gmail.com>

scripts.pack: npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --dir
scripts.dist:deb: npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:appimage: npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never -c.afterPack=build/after-pack-appimage.cjs
scripts.dist: npm run dist:deb && npm run dist:appimage
